stem: 一家金融机构正在探索采用自动化手段来协助调查人员审查被标记的交易。目前，调查人员花费大量时间从多个来源收集数据。以下哪项自动化功能最能有效提高调查人员的工作效率？

options.A: 预填充的可疑活动报告（SAR）申报模板
options.B: 集成开源工具以收集实时情报
options.C: 基于风险评分的自动化案件优先级排序
options.D: AI驱动的被标记交易汇总仪表板

stem_en: A financial institution is exploring automation to assist investigators in reviewing flagged transactions. Currently, investigators spend a significant amount of time gathering data from multiple sources. Which of the following automation features would be most effective in improving investigator efficiency?

options_en.B: Integration of open-source tools to gather real-time intelligence
options_en.C: Automated case prioritization based on risk scoring
